prs.title: Meta: Upgrade ESMeta to v0.8.1
prs.author: arcde40
prs.body:
This PR updates the version of ESMeta to [v0.8.0](https://github.com/es-meta/esmeta/releases/tag/v0.8.0) with the following key updates:
* https://github.com/es-meta/esmeta/pull/345
* https://github.com/es-meta/esmeta/pull/353
* https://github.com/es-meta/esmeta/pull/347
* https://github.com/es-meta/esmeta/pull/348
* https://github.com/es-meta/esmeta/pull/358

This version removes `SnapToInteger` from `esmeta-ignore.json`, but newly adds five algorithms:
* `BigIntBitwiseOp`
* `DecimalEscape[0,1].CapturingGroupNumber`
* `INTRINSICS.Function.prototype.bind`
* `TimeString`
* `TimeZoneString`

All of them are false alarms in newly supported features, caused by a limitation in the current type inference: integer and range constraints are over-approximated to `Math` through arithmetic operations. For example, in `BigIntBitwiseOp`, the arguments to `BinaryAnd`/`BinaryOr`/`BinaryXor` are always 0 or 1 by modulo 2, but inferred as `Math` rather than `Int[0, 1]`.

prs.title: Editorial: Use the String exotic object type in StringGetOwnProperty
prs.author: linusg

prs.title: Editorial: change return value of SetViewValue from undefined to unused
prs.author: Jack-Works
prs.body: I found this when refactoring engine262. The return value of this AO does not represent a meaningful ECMAScript value; therefore, I think it is better to change it as in this PR.
